Subject: Visit Update – [Business Name/Location]

Hi [Manager’s Name],

I visited [Business Name] at [Location] today to introduce/discuss our [product/service]. During the conversation, I found out that this location is only a branch, and purchasing/partnership decisions are handled by their head office.

The branch representative I spoke with was [Name, if available], and they provided the following contact email for the head office:

Email: [Head Office Email]

They advised that we should reach out directly to the head office for further discussions or approval.

Next steps:
- Send an introductory email to the head office
- Include details of our product/service and value proposition
- Follow up after [number of days] if there is no response

Please let me know if you would like me to contact them directly or if you prefer to handle the follow-up.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
